info.title: Relay Gateway API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible, multi-tenant LLM gateway. Data-plane (/v1/*) surface.

get.summary: Return the authenticated caller (control plane)
get.description: Requires a Logto JWT: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with the `relay:read` scope. Returns 401 without a valid token and 403 without the scope.

get.summary: The purchasable plan catalog (public; empty in the self-hosted edition)
This organization’s effective limits, with provenance and current usage

post.summary: Move this organization to another public plan — takes effect within ~1s

get.summary: Read any organization’s subscription

put.summary: Assign a plan, set per-contract overrides, or extend a trial

get.summary: List every delivery channel this organization has configured
Read one delivery channel (never returns the secret)

put.summary: Configure a delivery channel. SMTP takes host/port/from_address; Slack and Teams take webhook_url. Omit the secret to keep the stored one.

post.summary: Send a test message through this channel and report what the provider said

get.summary: List every notification event with this organization’s setting

put.summary: Enable/disable one event and set extra recipients

get.summary: Delivery log — every notification and what happened to it

post.summary: Onboard a new organization (Logto org + entitlements + admin invite)

get.summary: List organizations
Retrieve an organization

post.summary: Suspend an organization (data plane rejects its keys ≤1s later)

get.summary: Read an organization's entitlement flags

post.summary: Advance the onboarding state machine one step

get.summary: List an organization’s members

delete.summary: Remove a member from the organization

put.summary: Set what a member may do in the organization (admin or member)

post.summary: Invite an email address into the organization (sends the invitation mail)

get.summary: List the organization’s invitations (newest first)

post.summary: Send the invitation mail again (pending invitations only)

delete.summary: Revoke a pending invitation (frees the address to be invited again)

get.summary: Read the invitation addressed to the signed-in caller

post.summary: Accept an invitation — joins the signed-in caller to the organization

get.summary: List applications
Retrieve an application

post.summary: Issue a virtual key (plaintext returned once)

get.summary: List an application’s virtual keys (never returns secrets)

post.summary: Rotate a key: issue a successor, grace the predecessor
Revoke a key immediately (data plane rejects it ≤1s later)
Store a provider credential (sealed on write, never returned)

get.summary: List provider credentials (metadata only)
Retrieve a provider credential (metadata only)
Grouped usage/spend for the caller’s organization (reads hourly rollups)
Cross-org spend summary grouped by org (platform-admin only)
List the organization’s spend budgets (at most one per period)

put.summary: Set (create or replace) the budget for a period — takes effect within ~1s

delete.summary: Remove the budget for a period (stops enforcing any ceiling)

put.summary: Set the budget for one application (applies in ADDITION to any org-wide ceiling)

delete.summary: Remove one application’s budget (the org-wide ceiling still applies)

get.summary: List the organization’s audit trail (newest first)
List routes with their active-version summary

post.summary: Create a route (optionally with an initial active version)

get.summary: Retrieve a route with all versions and targets

delete.summary: Delete a route and all its versions

post.summary: Add a new version to a route (not activated automatically)
Activate a version (rollback = activate an older one)

get.summary: List recent requests (most recent first)
Live request feed (Server-Sent Events)
get.description: text/event-stream of traffic.event objects for the caller’s org.

get.summary: Trace detail: all events for a request/trace id

post.summary: Create a chat completion (streaming or non-streaming)
post.description: OpenAI-compatible. Requires a virtual key: `Authorization: Bearer rk_live_…`. With `stream:true` the response is an SSE stream of `chat.completion.chunk` events.

200.description: A chat.completion object, or an SSE stream when stream=true.

schema.description: A chat.completion object, or an SSE stream when stream=true.

get.summary: List available models
Retrieve a model by id
